description: accounts' answer: the accounts and defaults as they are after it, and whether the host has claude and what it lacks of each provider's program (with error, if it couldn't be done); usage's, the limits; sign_in's, each line the sign-in writes (line alone), then its end.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

error.description: Why it couldn't be done, for the user as it is.

accounts.description: The host's accounts, by provider then name.

claude.description: Claude's default account's id, "" for the CLI's own sign-in.

defaults.description: Each provider's default for new chats.

usage.description: usage: the subscription's limits; null where they can't be read for its sign-in (a setup token's, an API key's).

line.description: sign_in: a line the sign-in wrote (the page to open, or Codex's device code, among them).

claude_cli.description: Whether the host has claude: a Claude account there is a folder signed in to with claude auth login; without it, a token from claude setup-token.

missing.description: What the host lacks of a provider's program, by provider (codex: its Codex CLI, as deps says it); a provider that's there isn't in it. Shown in place of Add account.

who.description: sign_in (Claude's), signed in: who as, as claude auth status says.
